candidate_title: Predicting Inductive Biases of Pre-Trained Models

review_output.decision_rationale: The title and abstract describe pre-trained models and analysis of linguistic features/structure, but do not clearly establish that the study is specifically about Transformer-based language models, nor that it empirically assesses syntactic structure or syntactic knowledge as opposed to broader linguistic features and decision heuristics. Because the required inclusion criteria are unresolved at Stage 1, this should route forward rather than be excluded.
review_output.route_reason: Unclear from title/abstract whether the models are Transformer-based and whether the empirical analysis is specifically about syntax.

evidence_ledger.quote: Most current NLP systems are based on a pre-train-then-fine-tune paradigm, in which a large neural network is first trained in a self-supervised way
Work that analyzes the representations that result from pre-training (via classifiers) finds that rich features of linguistic structure can be decoded with high accuracy
